'''Tainted Shell''' is a [[Corrupted Mod]] that increases the [[accuracy]] of Shotgun fire by +7% per rank while also decreasing the [[fire rate]] by -5% per rank for a maximum of increase accuracy by +77% and reduced [[fire rate]] by -55% at rank 10.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Adding this mod does '''not''' decrease Shotgun falloff damage.

==Tips==
*The DPS-averse nature of this mod, the opportunity cost  of slotting it, a high capacity requirement, and the fact that it's not an Exilus mod give it a fairly narrow applicability.
**The fire rate reduction can be counteracted by using {{M|Shotgun Barrage}} or similar, but if this was the primary reason to slot such a mod, it would cause the opportunity cost to effectively double.
**The fire rate reduction can be nullified by [[Semi-Shotgun Cannonade]]
*{{Weapon|Tigris}}, because of it's duplex trigger, can benefit from this mod with practically no drawback. {{Weapon|Sancti Tigris}} comes with an innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity.
**The decrease in fire rate increases the delay before the Tigris automatically reloads after emptying it's magazine. This can be remedied by pressing the Reload button right after firing the second shot
**If Tigris is given more than 2 shots per magazine with appropriate mods, or if the weapon gets corrupted in a [[Void Fissure]], the delay after every 2 shots is increased noticeably.
*Similarly to the above, {{Weapon|Exergis}} benefits from this mod, as it also has an innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity, and is able to ignore the fire rate penalty due to being single-shot.
**This is true despite the weapon already having the second-narrowest firing cone of all shotguns, behind {{Weapon|Astilla}}, since it also has an extremely low pellet count: this mod makes it easier to hit a target with all pellets, and deal full damage to it.
*It is somewhat suitable for shotguns with a higher fire rate and wide spread like {{Weapon|Boar}} and {{Weapon|Boar Prime}}, as it makes it possible to concentrate fire on a single target, at distances greater than point-blank range.
*Due to its lack of falloff damage, this mod is useful in decreasing the spread of {{Weapon|Drakgoon}} allowing it to hit distant enemies more effectively, without charging the shot.
*Adding this mod to {{Weapon|Phage}} will narrow the ''initial'' cone of the beams.

==Trivia==
*This is the first mod to reduce the actual spread of gunfire, rather than simply the [[recoil]].

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than just simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.}} The '''Telos Akbolto''' is an exclusive version of the {{Weapon|Akbolto}} available only from the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}}. Featuring significantly improved [[status chance]] at the expense of critical stats, the Telos Akbolto also possesses an innate [[Truth]] effect. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. *On kill, bodies will follow the bolt that killed them, damaging anyone in their path and pinning the corpse to walls. *Innate [[Truth]] effect. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} and {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities. {{Advantages| *Tied with {{Weapon|Akbolto}} for the fastest fire rate of all semi-auto pistols. *No initial spread. Spread increases very slightly on subsequent shots. }} {{Disadvantages| *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Akbolto}} {{WeaponComparison|Akbolto Prime|header=n}} ==Acquisition== *The Telos Akbolto can be acquired by reaching the Rank of '''Maxim''' with the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}}, and spending {{sc|100,000}} to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Telos Akbolto cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Maxim rank. *Syndicate weapons can be also be acquired via [[Trade System|Trading]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. *Players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 11 to acquire the Telos Akbolto, either through trading or through the Syndicates themselves. ==Tips== *Focused on {{D|Puncture}} damage, therefore effective against [[Corpus]] and [[Corrupted|Corrupted.]] *For effective use of non-hitscan weapons, it is strongly recommended to learn leading. In short, leading means aiming ahead of your target so the projectile hits them at their predicted location. *Moderate recoil makes fast subsequent shots more difficult to land when fire rate mods are used. *Using the {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} mod can help regain lost ammo when needed. *With a decently leveled {{M|Magnum Force}} and fully leveled [[multishot]] mods such as {{M|Barrel Diffusion}} and {{M|Lethal Torrent}} these pistols visibly fire 2-3 bolts per shot. When used over a longer range this results in the Telos Akbolto having the effective use of "spray and pray" weapons whilst retaining respectable damage output and ammo economy. *The bolts spawn as physical objects at the muzzle of the Telos Akbolto. **If an enemy is standing right in front of you, so that the muzzle is '''inside''' of them, you will sometimes not be able to hit, because the Telos Akbolto is non-hitscan and pretty long, so the bolts spawn behind the hitbox of that enemy. **Also if taking cover behind a thick object (i.e. door case) you will not be able to shoot anything but the wall in front you if the muzzle is '''inside''' of that object. *The innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity is perfect for [[Galvanized Shot]] or modding [[Viral]] damage with [[Deep Freeze]]. ==Trivia== *The word ''telos'' means an ultimate end or goal, derived from Greek ''teleology'', essentially the study of purpose. *The Telos Akbolto was the first item to hold the "''Telos''" prefix. The [[Telos Syandana]] was second. ==Media== TelosAkboltoCodex.png|Telos Akbolto in Codex. {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|eyvFVUQotis|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|itf0s6WK398|size=300px}} }} {{clr}} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} ;SEMI-AUTOMATIC WEAPON CHANGES While reviewing the stats of some weapons with a semi-automatic mode, we noticed that certain weapons had an unsustainably high fire rate for most players. We adjusted the stats of the following semi-automatic weapons whose maximum potential was only being reached with the use of macros (to learn more about third-party use in Warframe visit our [https://digitalextremes.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030014351-Third-Party-Software-and-You support article]). Since not everyone is an avid macro user (within the boundaries allowed), '''we lowered fire rates to a more humanly achievable level and improved their damage or reload stats to compensate.''' '''Telos Akbolto''' *Reduced fire rate from 10 to 5. *Increased damage from 47 to 70. *Reduced reload time from 2.6 to 2. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 6 to 11 *[[Status chance]] increased from 12.5% to 29% *[[Critical chance]] increased from 10 to 13% *Damage decreased from 50 to 47. {{ver|Specters of the Rail 2.2}} *Fixed enemies not being alerted by the Telos AkBolto. {{ver|17.4}} *Fixed missing weapon trails from projectiles created by the Telos Akbolto. {{ver|16.8.1}} *Ormolu Skin now works on the Telos Akbolto! {{ver|15.13}} *Fixed unique energy colors not applying to the Telos Akbolto. {{ver|15.5}} *Introduced. }}

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.}} The '''Talons''' are {{Faction|Tenno}} throwing bombs, functioning like throwing knives that stick to targets when thrown, dealing {{D|Blast}} damage in a small radius when manually detonated via [[Alternate Fire]]. This weapon can be sold for ‍'''5,000'''. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Blast}} damage. *Explosion deals '''250''' damage when stuck to a surface, including enemies and allies. *Guaranteed {{D|Puncture}} proc. *Mines stick to surfaces, including enemies and allies. **Can only have eight deployed mines out at once. ***Extra projectiles generated by [[Multishot]] will count towards this limit. **Extra projectiles generated by [[Multishot]] have a very wide horizontal spread, effective at covering large groups of enemies. *User can detonate charges on command via [[Alternate Fire]], giving the player precise timing in detonation. **Detonation has an explosion radius of '''4''' meters. **Up to eight deployed mines can be ready for simultaneous detonation. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). *Innate two {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities. {{Advantages| *Fourth highest base damage of all throwing-type secondaries, behind {{Weapon|Pox}}, {{Weapon|Castanas}}, and {{Weapon|Sancti Castanas}}. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. *High projectile velocity, making them easy to use at range. *[[Noise Level|Silent]], even if the projectile hits the enemy. }} {{Disadvantages| *Semi-automatic fire, unlike other throwing weapons. *Tied with {{Weapon|Pox}} for second lowest magazine size of all throwing-type secondaries, behind {{Weapon|Castanas}}/{{Weapon|Sancti Castanas}}. *Extremely low ammo capacity of 12; requires just 3 reloads to fully deplete all ammo reserves. *Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 50% from central impact. }} ==Acquisition== The Talons's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Media== TalonsCodex.png|Talons in Codex. Talons_Codex.jpeg|Talons in the Codex. {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|ydPWWGJQeAE|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|QkGWC1_gdS4|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|iLvkvaerr3U|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|6zY3TOlnq7k|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} *Fixed the Critical Chance and Status Chance stats not being listed for the Talons in the Arsenal. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 4 Ammo per Pick Up: *Talons ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. ;GENERAL CHANGES: *Updated thrown weapons to now only show a single projectile in hand when only one 1 projectile is remaining before reloading. This affects the following weapons: **Talons {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Talons: 50% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|22.20}} ;Conclave: *Reduced the ammo pool of the Talons. *Increased the effect of gravity on the Talons. {{ver|22.13.3}} *Made the additional projectiles of Talons and Castanas from Multishot spread in a more uniform/predictable pattern. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 5 to 8. *Status chance increased from 10% to 26%. *Critical chance increased from 5% to 22%. *Critical damage increased from 1.5x to 2x. *Multishot now spreads additional projectiles horizontal only. *Ammo capacity decreased from 20 to 12. }} {{ResearchNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Talons]] [[es:Talons]] [[fr:Talons]] [[Category:Update 18]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Research]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Thrown]] [[Category:Silent]] [[uk:Кігті]] [[Category:Blast Damage Weapons]]

{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Parvos Granum’s engineers have made this already ferocious hand-cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.}} The '''Tenet Detron''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Detron}} pistol shotgun, featuring enhanced [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], overall [[status chance]] due to increased [[multishot]] despite its base status being lowered, and [[accuracy]] that exceeds the {{Weapon|Mara Detron}}, along with a slight increase to magazine size, at the cost of a steep damage penalty. It has gained an [[Alternate Fire]] that burst-fires its entire magazine. ==Characteristics== *This weapon primarily deals {{D|Radiation}} damage. *[[Alternate Fire]] shoots all remaining ammunition in the magazine in a quick burst. **Benefits from magazine increasing mods to further increase the burst's damage. *Can use the {{Weapon|Detron}}-exclusive {{M|Thermagnetic Shells}} mod. *Adversary Weapon: **Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%. ***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%). **[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity. **{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely. **Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Very high overall [[status chance]]. *Good [[accuracy]]. *Innate [[multishot]] of 10 pellets. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 55% from 26m to 52m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Detron}} {{WeaponComparison|Mara Detron}} ==Acquisition== {{Transclude|Adversary System/Weapons#Tenet Acquisition (Sister)}} ==Notes== *The [[Alternate Fire]] of the Tenet Detron will eject all of the remaining ammunition in the magazine in a single burst. **Base effective fire rate is '''8''' rounds per second. ***The burst is affected by [[Fire Rate]] mods, but not perfectly; +60% Fire Rate only resulted in roughly +45% effect. **Increasing the magazine size of the weapon such as with {{M|Slip Magazine}} ({{M|Primed Slip Magazine|Primed}}) and {{M|Tainted Clip}}, and using recoil reduction mods like {{M|Steady Hands}}, can help to make its damage output more consistent and reliable. **If buffed with unlimited ammo such as from the [[Void Fissure#Reactant Buff|Reactant Buff]], the weapon will only fire a burst equal to its current magazine, with small delays between each trigger pull. **Alternate Fire can be canceled using quick melee. **Aiming will be disabled for the duration of the burst, and so the Alternate Fire cannot benefit from [[Acolyte Mods]]. *The ability to to unload all its magazine in one powerful burst is shared with the Grineer {{Weapon|Kuva Kraken}}, {{WF|Octavia}}'s {{Weapon|Pandero}} ({{Weapon|Pandero Prime|Prime}}), and the [[Amalgam]] {{Weapon|Cyanex}}. *Despite the lower base damage compared to its predecessors, the Tenet Detron's increased [[Multishot]] (10 pellets vs. 7 pellets) results in higher overall damage even with the {{Codex|Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from the hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.}}
The '''Tenet Diplos''' are unique [[Tenet]] akimbo pistols with fully automatic fire, an [[Zoom|aimed]] fire mode that locks-on to enemies with burst-fire seeking projectiles, and is able to reload while [[holster]]ed.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Impact}} damage.
*[[Zoom|Aiming]] activates lock-on mode, targeting up to '''8''' enemies within '''60''' meters on the reticle to burst-fire 2 shots of seeking projectiles per target.
**Lock-on homing targets the enemy's body, making it difficult to achieve headshots unless aiming upward.
**Lock-on projectiles must travel 5 meters before seeking.
**Lock-on burst-fire consumes '''4''' ammo ('''2''' per pistol) per target.
**Lock-on has a ~0.5 second delay after the burst ends before being able to lock-on again (affected by [[fire rate]]).
*Reloads '''10%''' of its magazine per second while [[holster]]ed.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped.

{{Advantages|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
*Innate 1 meter [[punch through]].
*Reloads '''8''' rounds per second while [[holster]]ed.
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Projectiles have travel time.
*Very heavy, side-to-side recoil, making the pinpoint accuracy only effective for the first shot.
}}

==Acquisition==

==Notes==
*[[Zoom|Aiming]] toggles lock-on mode.
**Up to a maximum of 8 targets can be locked-on by aiming at enemies within 60 meters, indicated by the circular reticle.
**Locked-on targets are marked by a white diamond that flashes bright at successful home-in.
**If the target moves ? meters away or dies while being aimed at, their lock-ons are removed.
**Full-auto fire can still be used by firing from hip-fire and then zooming in or not aiming over an enemy to not trigger the lock-on.
**Lock-on mode is disabled against targets with invulnerability, such as enemies being corrupted by a [[Void Fissure]], as well as those taking cover inside a [[Nullifier Crewman|Nullifier]] bubble. It is, however, enabled for enemies protected by [[Arbitration Shield Drone|Arbitration Shield Drones]].
**Lock-on does not work with {{WF|Cyte-09}}'s {{A|Seek}}, targets cannot be acquired through walls and homing shots will not pierce walls.
*While holstered, the attaché case's components will rumble and make an audible sound for each ammo reloaded.
**Passive reload stacks with {{M|Eject Magazine}} and the Synth Mod Set ({{M|Synth Deconstruct}}, {{M|Synth Fiber}}, {{M|Synth Reflex}} and {{M|Synth Charge}}).
*Similar to the {{Weapon|Velox}}, these weapons are functionally silent despite having an "Alarming" noise level; they can be fired near enemies without alerting them unless a bullet hits a surface very close to them. However, they will still break {{WF|Ivara}}'s {{A|Prowl}} unless the {{M|Suppress}} mod is equipped.

{{Transclude|Adversary System/Progenitor}}

== Known Bugs ==
* {{M|Galvanized Shot}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from lock-on mode.

==Tips==
*The Diplos has noticeable recoil, so it is recommended to fire the guns at short bursts or mitigate the recoil with {{M|Steady Hands}}.
*If not using lock-on mode, hip-firing and then ADS will grant the bonuses of aiming without enabling the lock-on mechanic.
*When using lock-on mode, wait until the lock-on indicator flashes before pulling the trigger to ensure that the gun will not go full auto mode. This is particularly useful when in the middle of an encounter with too much visual noise, such as explosions from an allied player's weapons or being struck by a {{D|Magnetic}} proc.
*The Diplos cannot lock in on [[Arbitration Shield Drone]]s, making the guns ineffective at disposing them. Additionally, the lock-on mode is enabled against enemies protected by the drone, wasting shots on invulnerable targets.
*You can start hip firing then ADS to keep the Diplos full-auto to make use of mods like [[Galvanized Crosshairs]] easier.

==Trivia==
*While holstered and while reloading, the weapon folds up into an attaché case.
*The weapon's name means "twofold", referring to how the weapon folds when (un)sheathed.
*Tenet Diplos lacks the "Dual" naming scheme seen with other Corpus akimbo weapons (e.g. {{Weapon|Dual Cestra}}).

==Bugs==
*Aiming down sights away from an enemy and using an autoclicker or mousewheel to fire the weapon causes it to fire as fast as the inputs register. This has no practical application as moving the reticle over an enemy immediately causes the lock-on function to activate.
*The Diplos used to be able to lock in on [[Arbitration Shield Drone]]s, making the guns effective at disposing them. Additionally, the lock-on mode was disabled against enemies protected by the drone, preventing the player from wasting shots on invulnerable targets. This behavior has now been reversed. As it is an undocumented change, it is likely a bug.
